metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory (1,072 controls; the episode ends with success after 952, 120 hold rows of slack) in both modes; it passes two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes and still succeeds with rows rounded to float32.

notes.layout: Two hands of the selected model, each on its own six-axis wrist stage (no arm): the left hand at the +y end of the tray, the right hand at the -y end. Every row holds both stages' targets and both hands' finger targets (layout below).
